_about: Per-tab CCL manifests (voice_guide_redesign.md sections 3, 8, 9). Each tab declares its supported verbs (caps) and its knob dimensions with a DOM binding + spoken aliases. Consumed by BOTH the shell (explorer.html builds the active tab's ctx from this) and the coverage audit (every live interactive control on a tab must be a bound knob or an explicit exclusion -- unbound control => loud pre-push failure, section 9). Adding a T1 tab is ONE entry here plus a knowledge default file -- never a new tool, prompt, or session-schema change. Knob `values[].v` are the real DOM option values (NOT their display labels); `aka` are the spoken forms a user would say. Keys beginning with _ are documentation and ignored by consumers.

sociogram._knobs_note: Sociogram's affordances are filters/selection/highlight/camera (their own dim kinds, not `set` knobs). It carries no `set` verb in v1. Listed here so the shell can read one uniform per-tab source; its caps mirror the engine's SOCIOGRAM_CAPS until step 2 migrates the shell to read caps from this file.

metabolism._caps_note: reset/restore are deferred to step 2b: they need a per-tab boot-captured snapshot of all knob dims (redesign section 7), whereas the v1 shell only captures Sociogram bootFilters. Until 2b they report unsupported_here on metabolism (honest, never faked). undo/redo work now via the absolute-vector journal (tab-agnostic).
metabolism._controls_note: The 4 knobs above are the controls found by static read of metabolism_view.html (selects #view/#metric/#color, checkbox #logy). Step 2 runs the LIVE runtime-DOM coverage audit in the debug panel (section 9); any interactive control it finds that is neither a bound knob nor listed in controls_excluded is a loud failure. Reconcile this list against that audit before the first metabolism No-Blind-Push.
